verdict.rationale: Proton Pass publishes client source on GitHub, including an Android repo with local build instructions, and a Proton representative states it is open source. Community reports say only the clients are open, not the server, and the evidence never names a license. missing for 10: server-side source, an explicitly named open-source license, and documentation of which repositories (browser extension, desktop, CLI) are covered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: If you want to build the app locally, please refer to the [BUILD.md](./docs/public/BUILD.md) file.
And it is open source: https://github.com/protonpass
User notes only the iOS and Android clients are open source, not the server implementation
